title: Golfland Sunsplash
specs: Over 30 rides and attractions at Sunsplash Water Park
Climate controlled 20,000 sq.ft. arcade building for severe weather
Children under 12 must be accompanied by someone 16 or older
Drivers for go-carts must be at least 18 years old and 60" tall
Passengers for go-carts must be at least 3 years old, 40" tall, 45 lbs, and have upper-body control
Children under 8 and/or 44" must ride bumper boats with an adult
Children under 48" must wear US Coast Guard approved life jackets in wave pool
Toddlers must wear swim diapers or diaper covers
Group packages for 15 to 4,000 people with customizable options and food packages
Five shaded private pavilions available for corporate events

blurb: Guests can enjoy Sunsplash Water Park with over 30 rides and attractions, plus unlimited Golfland attractions like mini golf, race cars, laser tag, bumper cars, and bumper boats. The park offers cabana rentals, group event packages, birthday parties, and season passes. The water park operates from mid-May through mid-September, with some slides opening as early as March for Spring Break.
extraNote: Free return ticket if park closes before 3pm; evening or Night Splash ticket if later · No cash refunds for bad weather or electrical failure · Cabana rentals refundable if park closes within 4 hours of reservation start and less than 4 hours used · No refunds on cabana rentals after 4 hours of use · No rain checks within 45 minutes of closing time · Mid-May through Mid-September for water park; Golfland open daily year-round
